claims.value: United States of Brazil — federal republic

scope.description: Historical entity institutions and associated activity; no polygon-derived territorial claims.

evidence.note: Existing1891constitutional framework, selected interior years only.

claims.value: States adopted their own constitutions within federal principles and retained residual powers; municipal autonomy was guaranteed, while states could neither declare war nor reject federally authorised money.

scope.description: Historical entity institutions and associated activity; no polygon-derived territorial claims.

evidence.note: Grouped institutional allocation of authority; constitutional rules do not imply uniformly effective local autonomy.

claims.value: Electoral registration required citizenship and age over21; the constitution excluded illiterate people, beggars, certain enlisted ranks and members of religious orders bound by obedience.
